verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents an official MCP server that connects AI tools directly to meeting data (fireflies-docs-34, fireflies-probe-3), with an OAuth integration needing no API keys (fireflies-docs-30). It supports natural-language querying of meetings (fireflies-docs-8, fireflies-docs-24) and lists MCP tools such as fireflies_share_meeting, fireflies_move_meeting and fireflies_create_soundbite (fireflies-docs-42, fireflies-docs-43, fireflies-docs-44). Missing for 10: explicit evidence of MCP tools for search, transcript retrieval and action items; documented Claude/generic-MCP-client OAuth setup (only ChatGPT shown); independent or hands-on corroboration.
